audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for cleansing, centurion faith/trust, authority under authority, Peter's mother-in-law, Isaiah healing citation, discipleship cost, storm calming, and Gadarene/Gerasene deliverance scene using careful spirit-language.

verses.restored: When Jesus came down from the mountain, great crowds followed him.

familiar.text: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

modern.text: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.

original.text: ⸂Καταβάντος δὲ αὐτοῦ⸃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί.

verses.restored: And look, a man with a skin disease came, bowed/prostrated before him, and said, Lord, if you are willing, you are able to cleanse me.

familiar.text: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

modern.text: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρὸς ⸀προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων· Κύριε, ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.

verses.restored: Stretching out his hand, Jesus touched him, saying, I am willing; be cleansed. And immediately his skin disease was cleansed.

familiar.text: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

modern.text: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

original.text: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο ⸀αὐτοῦ λέγων· Θέλω, καθαρίσθητι· καὶ εὐθέως ἐκαθαρίσθη αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα.

verses.restored: Jesus said to him, See that you tell no one, but go show yourself to the priest and offer the gift Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.

familiar.text: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

modern.text: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.” The Faith of the Centurion (Luke 7:1–10; John 4:43–54)

original.text: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὅρα μηδενὶ εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ, καὶ προσένεγκον τὸ δῶρον ὃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

verses.restored: When he entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, pleading with him,

familiar.text: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

modern.text: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,

original.text: ⸂Εἰσελθόντος δὲ αὐτοῦ⸃ εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἑκατόνταρχος παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν

verses.restored: Lord, my servant is lying in the house paralyzed, terribly tormented.

familiar.text: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

modern.text: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”

original.text: καὶ λέγων· Κύριε, ὁ παῖς μου βέβληται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ παραλυτικός, δεινῶς βασανιζόμενος.

verses.restored: He said to him, I will come and heal him.

familiar.text: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.

modern.text: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.

original.text: ⸀καὶ λέγει ⸀αὐτῷ· Ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν θεραπεύσω αὐτόν.

verses.restored: But the centurion answered, Lord, I am not worthy that you should come under my roof, but only speak a word and my servant will be healed.

familiar.text: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

modern.text: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

original.text: ⸂καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς⸃ ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος ἔφη· Κύριε, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς ἵνα μου ὑπὸ τὴν στέγην εἰσέλθῃς· ἀλλὰ μόνον εἰπὲ λόγῳ, καὶ ἰαθήσεται ὁ παῖς μου·

verses.restored: For I also am a man under authority, having soldiers under me; I say to this one, Go, and he goes, and to another, Come, and he comes, and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

familiar.text: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

modern.text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”

original.text: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπός εἰμι ὑπὸ ⸀ἐξουσίαν, ἔχων ὑπʼ ἐμαυτὸν στρατιώτας, καὶ λέγω τούτῳ· Πορεύθητι, καὶ πορεύεται, καὶ ἄλλῳ· Ἔρχου, καὶ ἔρχεται, καὶ τῷ δούλῳ μου· Ποίησον τοῦτο, καὶ ποιεῖ.

verses.restored: When Jesus heard, he marveled and said to those following, Amen, I say to you, with no one in Israel have I found such great trust.

familiar.text: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

modern.text: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

original.text: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀκολουθοῦσιν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ⸂παρʼ οὐδενὶ τοσαύτην πίστιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ⸃ εὗρον.

verses.restored: I say to you that many will come from east and west and recline with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the reign of the heavens.

familiar.text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

modern.text: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

original.text: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν ἥξουσιν καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν·

verses.restored: But the sons of the reign will be cast into the outer darkness; there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

familiar.text: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

modern.text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

original.text: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας ἐκβληθήσονται εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

verses.restored: Jesus said to the centurion, Go; let it happen for you as you trusted. And the servant was healed in that hour.

familiar.text: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

modern.text: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Mark 1:29–34; Luke 4:38–41)

original.text: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ· Ὕπαγε, ⸀ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι· καὶ ἰάθη ὁ ⸀παῖς ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.

verses.restored: Jesus came into Peter's house and saw his mother-in-law lying sick with fever.

familiar.text: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.

modern.text: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.

original.text: Καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Πέτρου εἶδεν τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτοῦ βεβλημένην καὶ πυρέσσουσαν·

verses.restored: He touched her hand, the fever left her, and she rose and served him.

familiar.text: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

modern.text: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them.

original.text: καὶ ἥψατο τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ διηκόνει αὐτῷ.

verses.restored: When evening came, they brought to him many troubled by unclean spirits, and he cast out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick,

familiar.text: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

modern.text: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

original.text: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δαιμονιζομένους πολλούς· καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ πνεύματα λόγῳ, καὶ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ἐθεράπευσεν·

verses.restored: so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled: He took our weaknesses and carried our diseases.

familiar.text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

modern.text: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.” The Cost of Discipleship (Luke 9:57–62; Luke 14:25–33; John 6:59–66)

original.text: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Αὐτὸς τὰς ἀσθενείας ἡμῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ τὰς νόσους ἐβάστασεν.

verses.restored: Seeing a crowd around him, Jesus commanded them to depart to the other side.

familiar.text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

modern.text: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.

original.text: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ⸂πολλοὺς ὄχλους⸃ περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκέλευσεν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

verses.restored: A scribe came and said to him, Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.

familiar.text: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

modern.text: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”

original.text: καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς γραμματεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Διδάσκαλε, ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ.

verses.restored: Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes and birds of the heavens have nests, but the Son of Humanity has nowhere to lay his head.

familiar.text: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

modern.text: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”

original.text: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις, ὁ δὲ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ.

verses.restored: Another of the disciples said to him, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

familiar.text: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

modern.text: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

original.text: ἕτερος δὲ τῶν ⸀μαθητῶν εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθεῖν καὶ θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου.

verses.restored: But Jesus said to him, Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.

familiar.text: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

modern.text: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.” Jesus Calms the Storm (Psalms 107:1–43; Mark 4:35–41; Luke 8:22–25)

original.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ⸀λέγει αὐτῷ· Ἀκολούθει μοι, καὶ ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς.

verses.restored: When he entered the boat, his disciples followed him.

familiar.text: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

modern.text: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

original.text: Καὶ ἐμβάντι αὐτῷ ⸀εἰς πλοῖον ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: And look, a great shaking arose on the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves; but he was sleeping.

familiar.text: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

modern.text: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον καλύπτεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων, αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκάθευδεν.

verses.restored: They came and woke him, saying, Lord, save us; we are perishing.

familiar.text: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

modern.text: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”

original.text: καὶ ⸀προσελθόντες ἤγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Κύριε, ⸀σῶσον, ἀπολλύμεθα.

verses.restored: He said to them, Why are you fearful, ones of little trust? Then he rose, rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.

familiar.text: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

modern.text: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.

original.text: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Τί δειλοί ἐστε, ὀλιγόπιστοι; τότε ἐγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς ἀνέμοις καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.

verses.restored: The people marveled, saying, What sort of one is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him?

familiar.text: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

modern.text: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!” The Demons and the Pigs (Mark 5:1–20; Luke 8:26–39)

original.text: οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες· Ποταπός ἐστιν οὗτος ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ⸂αὐτῷ ὑπακούουσιν⸃;

verses.restored: When he came to the other side, to the region of the Gadarenes, two men troubled by unclean spirits met him, coming out from the tombs, very fierce, so that no one was strong enough to pass that way.

familiar.text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

modern.text: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

original.text: Καὶ ⸂ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ⸃ εἰς τὸ πέραν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν ⸀Γαδαρηνῶν ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ δύο δαιμονιζόμενοι ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἐξερχόμενοι, χαλεποὶ λίαν ὥστε μὴ ἰσχύειν τινὰ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐκείνης.

verses.restored: And look, they cried out, What to us and to you, Son of the Divine? Have you come here before the appointed time to torment us?

familiar.text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

modern.text: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔκραξαν λέγοντες· Τί ἡμῖν καὶ ⸀σοί, υἱὲ τοῦ θεοῦ; ἦλθες ὧδε πρὸ καιροῦ βασανίσαι ἡμᾶς;

verses.restored: Far from them a herd of many pigs was feeding.

familiar.text: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

modern.text: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.

original.text: ἦν δὲ μακρὰν ἀπʼ αὐτῶν ἀγέλη χοίρων πολλῶν βοσκομένη.

verses.restored: The spirits pleaded with him, saying, If you cast us out, send us into the herd of pigs.

familiar.text: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

modern.text: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

original.text: οἱ δὲ δαίμονες παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Εἰ ἐκβάλλεις ἡμᾶς, ⸂ἀπόστειλον ἡμᾶς⸃ εἰς τὴν ἀγέλην τῶν χοίρων.

verses.restored: He said to them, Go. They came out and went into the pigs; and look, the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

modern.text: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

original.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑπάγετε. οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἀπῆλθον εἰς ⸂τοὺς χοίρους⸃· καὶ ἰδοὺ ὥρμησεν πᾶσα ἡ ⸀ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἀπέθανον ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν.

verses.restored: Those tending them fled, went away into the city, and reported everything, including what had happened to the men troubled by spirits.

familiar.text: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

modern.text: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.

original.text: οἱ δὲ βόσκοντες ἔφυγον, καὶ ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα καὶ τὰ τῶν δαιμονιζομένων.

verses.restored: And look, all the city came out to meet Jesus; and when they saw him, they begged him to depart from their region.

familiar.text: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

modern.text: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ πόλις ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ⸀ὑπάντησιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν παρεκάλεσαν ὅπως μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.
